Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! I know it's a little nerve-wracking waiting on a new plant, so let me help.

**How long tracking takes to update**
- Tracking is emailed to you when your order ships, and it can take **up to 24 hours** to show any updates. So if your link was only just sent, it's very normal for it to look empty for now.

**When to reach out to us**
- If the tracking hasn't moved for **4 business days**, or it says delivered but nothing has arrived, contact us. We'll open a courier investigation, which can take **up to 5 business days**.
- If the parcel turns out to be lost, you can choose either a free replacement or a full refund.

**Good to know**
- Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only, so if your order was placed after 12 noon on Wednesday, it will ship the following Monday.
- If the weather is very cold (below 35°F) or very hot (above 95°F) along the route, your plant may be held for up to 7 days. We'd email you if that happened.

If you'd like, tell me roughly when you ordered and I can help work out whether everything's on track. Please don't hesitate to reach out again anytime. Happy plant-parenting! 🌿
